title: Benchmark renderer seams and remove proven bottlenecks
goal: Compare existing backend against a bounded engine-level rendering seam; avoid an unnecessary renderer rewrite.
acceptance: Correctness-preserving wins measured for shader prewarm, cache keys, copies, bindings and queue use
Choose one backend initially; preserve faithful fallback and disable optimizations that violate frame or gameplay semantics
validation: Matched replay cold/warm CPU/GPU p50/p95/p99 and memory comparison
Visual regression across vendor GPUs and split-screen
